name: GreenRoom
author: arothmanmusic

sections.description:
GreenRoom streamlines bio collection for a theatre production. Create a show, import the cast and staff via CSV, and each person receives a unique link to submit their bio, social media info, and headshot — no WordPress account required.

Producers manage the show through a public production dashboard without needing admin access. Bios can be exported to every format a playbill editor might need, including Adobe InDesign Tagged Text with paragraph and character style definitions.

Key Features

  • CSV import of cast and staff (name, email, role, designation)
  • Unique token-based submission links — no submitter account needed
  • Public production dashboard — producers manage their show without WordPress admin access
  • Drag-and-drop reordering for “In Order of Appearance” cast listings
  • Inline editing of names and roles directly on the production dashboard
  • Cast / Staff / Both designation — people can appear in both sections when needed
  • Optional unsectioned mode for productions that don’t separate cast and staff
  • Withdraw and reinstate people without deleting their data
  • Configurable bio length limits (words or characters)
  • Headshot upload with print-quality dimension validation
  • Per-show deadline that governs submission and editing
  • Returning actors recognized by email — bios pre-populated from previous shows
  • Weekly automated reminders via wp_cron plus on-demand trigger
  • Customizable email templates for invitations, reminders, confirmations, producer status updates, and playbill editor notices
  • Public bio display via [greenroom show="slug"] shortcode
  • Export bios in HTML, Markdown, RTF, DOCX, InDesign Tagged Text, or CSV
  • InDesign export uses UTF-16LE encoding with paragraph and character style definitions
  • Separate headshot export as ZIP
  • Configurable name and role formatting: case, bold, italic
  • Producer and admin can edit bios on behalf of submitters
sections.installation:
1. Upload the greenroom folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to GreenRoom → Settings to configure formatting options and bio limits.
  4. Create your first show under GreenRoom → Shows.
sections.faq:
How do submitters access their bio form?

Each person added to a show receives a unique URL containing an authentication token. Share these via the invitation email feature or manually from the People list.

How do producers manage their show?

When a show is created, a unique production link is generated. Share this with the producer or production team — they can manage cast and staff, send invitations and reminders, and export bios without needing a WordPress login.

What CSV format is expected?

Four columns: name, email, role, designation. Designation must be cast, staff, or both. Multiple rows with the same email will add multiple roles to that person.

Can someone be in both cast and staff?

Yes. Set their designation to both and they will appear in both the Cast and Staff sections on the dashboard and in exports. They submit a single bio and receive one invitation.

What if my theatre doesn’t separate cast and staff?

Uncheck “Cast / Staff Sections” under GreenRoom → Settings. The dashboard and exports will show a single unsectioned list of people.

What export formats are available?

HTML, Microsoft Word (DOCX), RTF, Markdown, Adobe InDesign Tagged Text, CSV, and headshot ZIP. Bio-content formats export only submitted bios. CSV includes full roster data including status. InDesign Tagged Text includes paragraph and character style definitions for professional playbill layout.

What happens after the deadline?

Submitters can no longer edit their bios. Data is retained in the database and remains accessible to admins and producers.

Is any data sent to a third-party service?

No. GreenRoom does not make external requests.
